title: Sweep query length and corpus size on intent-replica
description: Baseline is set: CPU cosine saturates ~155 rps, GPU cosine ~313 rps at 1 instance and ~430 rps at 2. Remaining axes to sweep: query token length (10-25), corpus size (corpus reads are the bandwidth cost, so halving it should roughly double CPU-cosine rps), max_queue_delay_microseconds, and max_batch_size. Use /tmp/conc.py on 7700x inside the triton container.
